Collection settings & difficult attempts

Collect from a device

These tags apply to future recordings from the selected device. Give each collection session a distinct name so its recordings can stay together when datasets are split.

Start Listen before speaking. Wait for the device to turn green, then say “Hey Adam” and your command. Manual recording pauses wake detection; it collects examples but does not measure automatic misses or run the command.

Archive limits

Recordings are never automatically deleted. When storage cannot accept a recording, normal voice processing continues and a warning appears here.

Collection never trains or installs a model. Reviewed dataset export and training are separate steps.

Gain changes playback only. The stored original and its hash stay unchanged.

Drag across the waveform to select “Hey Adam”, or set boundaries below. The gold line marks the pre-trigger boundary, not the exact chime timing. Listen to the selection and keep the acknowledgement chime outside it where possible.

A wake trigger or matching transcript is only a candidate. Approve a positive after listening and marking the phrase.
